rejected.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a SINGLE whole-character jumping PRELOAD pose reference for native 64x64 pixel tracing, NOT a sprite sheet. Input image is the identity reference of Tique, an original bronze robot in a 3/4 front-right view. Retain the EXACT very large round head, compact short torso, two vertical cyan eyes and cyan heart, short slender articulated arms and short legs, dark wine outline and original brass palette. Create exactly ONE isolated complete character, transparent background, filling a square canvas with 12% margins. Pose: deep but modest jump anticipation, both knees bend, torso/head lower about 5 native pixels, feet flat, elbows pull behind and outward, small bronze mitten hands CLEARLY visible to left and right OUTSIDE head and torso silhouettes, below head edge. Both arms visibly connect shoulder-elbow-hand; both feet and both hands unmistakable. Head remains the same huge size and angle, NEVER shrink it; torso stays compact, NEVER add bulky boots or large gloves. Clean bold pixel art with rectilinear pixels, no effects, no blur, no glows, no floor, no shadow, no text, no grid. Full silhouette and full interior body details; not a parts study. Keep cyan eyes and heart equally visible.
